description: IDAF - ATIVIDADE LICENCIADAS (EXCETO BARRAGEM) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Camada com geometria do tipo ponto, representando as atividades licenciadas pelo Instituto de Defesa Agropecuária e Florestal do ES - IDAF (exceto barragens). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are AGROPECUARIA, GELCOF, IDAF, LICENCIAMENTO AMBIENTAL, Brazil. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
